_comment: Task 408: curated demo corpus for the staging dataset. Each case is a REAL .eml from
data/test-corpus/emails (13,372-message PST dump of Jamee's mailbox). Only filenames are
committed here — the email content itself is rsynced to the isolated staging box, never
added to the repo. 'attachments' entries are sidecar files from
data/curtis-emails/attachments-jamee-sent (the PST export stripped attachments out of the
.eml files); the seeder MIME-bridges them back in exactly like monitor._parse_message_to_rfqs.
'confirm_ship_to': after ingest, mark the parsed ship-to as a stored human-confirmed customer
address (models a destination a human verified on an earlier order) so the ship_to_confirmed
signal can pass. Cases without it demo the 'unconfirmed ship-to' hold state.
